description: How loud the music plays under the narration, as a percent (0 silent to 100 full), the same slider as the Voiceover panel. It changes the mix only while narration plays; without narration the music plays at full level. Uses no credit; undoable. Keylight has no fade-in or fade-out control for the music volume.

volumePercent.description: Music level under the narration, 0 (silent) to 100 (full).

name: set_music_volume
title: Music volume under narration
